finding: No test asserts the ts field is stamped under the lock.
why: The delta moves ts from build_line to a post-lock fill-in; if the fill-in broke, every record would carry "ts":"" and no test would fail.
fix: Assert in the lost-lock or parallel test that each appended line's ts is non-empty and matches an ISO-8601 UTC pattern (and the minted record is not the rival line).
evidence: hooks/lesson-append.sh:181 line=${line/\"ts\":\"\"/\"ts\":\"$stamp\"}; grep of test_lesson_filing.py finds "ts" only in the rival fixture at line 296, never in an assertion

finding: Hand-back test relies on a fixed sleep(1) before a negative-state assertion.
why: If the waiter's mv has not run within 1 s on a loaded machine, the owner check sees the rival lock still in place and passes without proving the hand-back.
fix: Wait on an observable signal after the mv (for example a shadowed mv that touches a marker) instead of a fixed sleep.
